purpose: Before the headset replay: the installed app's native library and the model file it loads, checked on the laptop against the build record and the accepted A1 artifacts. Loading, runtime behaviour, context allocation and KV-cache types are checked later, by the running app
model_file_source: ChatPanel.cs, the default of its serialized field ggufFile
accepted_llama_cpp_source: native/llama.cpp.pin, as tools/build_llama.py records it in build.json and native/CMakeLists.txt compiles it into se_llama_version()
provenance_rule: A1.8c's command-line runs: grounding/llama_headset.py push copied into each run's raw/build.json the build record of the programs it ran. A deployed library whose SHA-256 equals the libse_llama.so hash in one of these records is linked to that A1.8c-era build. The in-app runs r032 to r036 recorded no library hash, so a link does not show that they used that exact binary, and a hash recorded today never becomes an acceptance-era pin
